visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person is holding a white PlayStation 5 controller, focusing on the textured grip on the back. A small handheld digital microscope device with a screen is held against the controller's surface, revealing a microscopic view of the tiny symbols. (2) The scene shifts to the same digital microscope being used on a 1000 New Taiwan Dollar bill. The microscope screen shows the face of the child on the bill, moving across the eye area with extreme magnification levels of 7x, 12x, and 19x, showing printed halftone patterns. (3) The microscope highlights a floral pattern on the bill, where hidden numbers like 1000, 2000, and 3000 are revealed under intense magnification. (4) A man wearing a black baseball cap and a black denim jacket stands in a workshop filled with various tools on a pegboard background. He holds the digital microscope and explains its features to the camera. (5) An endoscope attachment is shown entering a sink drain, with its live feed displayed on a smartphone screen next to the sink. (6) The man continues his presentation in the workshop, gesturing with his hands and holding up the microscope device while promotional graphics about membership discounts appear on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice begins speaking with high energy and clear articulation, presenting a curious tone. The background environment is a clean studio silence. (2) A cheerful acoustic guitar-driven BGM starts with a moderate tempo and steady beat. A slight mechanical click is heard as the microscope is moved. (3) A digital UI beep sound occurs as a '7x' graphic appears. The narrator's pitch rises with excitement when describing the microscopic PS5 symbols. (4) A soft whoosh transition sound accompanies a shift in the background music's intensity. The vocal delivery remains friendly and fast-paced, maintaining a professional broadcasting quality. (5) A bubbling sound effect is played as the endoscope is shown in the drain. The BGM continues smoothly in the background, lower in volume than the speech. (6) A final ding sound effect signals the presentation of the membership offer. The voice maintains a high arousal level until the track ends abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Explanation -> Product Intro -> Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the capabilities of the Anyty digital microscope by revealing hidden details on common items like a PS5 controller and currency, ultimately promoting a special membership discount for the product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly presents the product's features, mentions a specific Taiwanese distributor, and offers a membership-exclusive discount and extended warranty.
